sections.label: Procession and interruption
sections.detail: A measured chant, a rising companion and a clipped dance enter separately; the first paragraph reaches the dominant.

sections.label: The dance takes hold
sections.detail: Roles migrate across the nine players. Distinct longer phrases and delayed heads build toward the relative-major cadence.

sections.label: A room opens
sections.detail: The relative major opens with three to five lines and actual silences; the ensemble returns by stages through the minor subdominant.

sections.label: The ground shifts
sections.detail: Unequally delayed chromatic slips disturb the tonic. A later hurried chant and one-beat low dance chase lead to another dominant.

sections.label: Only a memory
sections.detail: Three cadential resolutions yield to an augmented cello chant with sparse answers, then the lower instruments return.

sections.label: Gathering
sections.detail: A moving bass earns an eight-beat dominant pedal; upper lines sustain, turn and cross the coming boundary.

sections.label: Return in pursuit
sections.detail: Delayed chant statements, inversion and displaced dance heads run through unequal phrase lengths. The horn prepares the major third.

sections.label: The procession takes flight
sections.detail: Brief breaths precede the full nine-line return. An augmented rising figure reaches the delayed crest, then the parts descend independently.

sections.label: Last turn home
sections.detail: A-flat major, F half-diminished, B-flat seventh and E-flat major; the individual resolutions precede the brief final chord.

pedagogy.characteristic_figure: A measured chant, a clipped 3+3+2 dance and a broad rising figure exchange roles across nine moving parts.

annotations.title: Answer and rising companion
annotations.text: The oboe answers higher. The viola introduces a separate rising idea beneath it.

annotations.title: A lower memory
annotations.text: The cello takes the chant while the earlier voices follow different continuations.

annotations.title: A clipped interruption
annotations.text: The violin interrupts with a four-beat dance head. Its three accents are separated by 3 + 3 + 2 half-beats.

annotations.title: The roles begin to move
annotations.text: The bassoon takes the dance; the flute takes the chant. Their phrase endings differ.

annotations.title: The last player enters
annotations.text: The bass bends the rising idea toward the first dominant cadence. Every player has now entered.

annotations.title: The dance takes hold
annotations.text: Clarinet and violin briefly share the dance in octaves. The surrounding lines keep the broader procession pace.

annotations.title: The dancer becomes the singer
annotations.text: The violin takes the chant; the inner strings and horn pass the rising idea and dance between them.

annotations.title: Nine overlapping phrases
annotations.text: The bass states the chant, the flute descends, and the clarinet climbs. The flute holds G-flat over the moving bass, then resolves to F.

annotations.title: A head passes between players
annotations.text: Short dance heads pass through cello, viola and flute, while longer sentences continue across them.

annotations.title: A directed cadence
annotations.text: The moving parts gather around D-flat seventh, preparing the relative major.

annotations.title: A room opens
annotations.text: G-flat major arrives; most players leave space. The quiet cello descent and upper answers become easier to follow.

annotations.title: Longer breathing
annotations.text: Three- and four-bar phrases enter at different times. Silence is part of the counterpoint.

annotations.title: A warmer shared memory
annotations.text: The chant briefly appears in octave colors while the other lines begin the return toward minor.

annotations.title: The route tightens
annotations.text: The separate lines recover the leading note and reach a B-flat-major dominant before the ground shifts.

annotations.title: One chromatic slip, unequal delays
annotations.text: F–F-flat–E-flat passes through three registers. The horn follows the viola after one and a half beats; the bassoon joins half a beat later.

annotations.title: The disturbance spreads
annotations.text: The altered chant moves lower. Longer phrases delay the coming chase instead of starting it immediately.

annotations.title: Two chases at once
annotations.text: Flute and violin hurry the chant. Horn, bass and cello enter the dance head one beat apart, then continue differently.

annotations.title: The answers keep changing
annotations.text: The broad rising idea resists the short heads; the chant also turns upward. Phrase endings remain displaced.

annotations.title: Toward a sudden retreat
annotations.text: The lines narrow toward another B-flat dominant. Its seventh will resolve when the ensemble falls away.

annotations.title: Only a memory
annotations.text: Three lines resolve the cadence. The cello then takes twice the chant’s original time, with sparse answering phrases.

annotations.title: The lower room returns
annotations.text: Viola, horn and bass enter gradually. A quiet minor route begins gathering toward the dominant.

annotations.title: Motion earns the pedal
annotations.text: The bass still walks. Different upper lines enter around it instead of arriving as one block.

annotations.title: Dominant pressure
annotations.text: Only now does the bass hold B-flat. Sustained notes, turns and a rising idea cross the coming return.

annotations.title: Return in pursuit
annotations.text: The violin states the chant; bassoon and oboe follow later. Other players continue phrases already in motion.

annotations.title: Changing foreground
annotations.text: An inner chant, an upward inversion, a chromatic memory and displaced dance heads pass between the parts.

annotations.title: The last minor approach
annotations.text: The separate lines move through the dominant and recover the tonic before the color begins to change.

annotations.title: One voice begins to brighten
annotations.text: The horn introduces G, the major third, before the other parts settle into the new color.

annotations.title: A breath before the crest
annotations.text: Horn and cello pause for a bar; bassoon waits longer. The continuing upper phrases preserve the motion.

annotations.title: Nine lines gather again
annotations.text: The last reentry restores all nine. The flute enlarges the rising figure to twice its length while short dance heads continue below.

annotations.title: The delayed high point
annotations.text: The flute reaches B-flat for three beats, then falls. Violin, horn, clarinet and cello follow their own overlapping arches.

annotations.title: Release with motion still inside
annotations.text: The bass arrives on E-flat. A low chant, delayed resolutions and descending phrases carry the release through another four bars.

annotations.title: A shadow in the last turn
annotations.text: A-flat major turns through F half-diminished. C-flat briefly recalls the opening minor world.

annotations.title: Different resolutions
annotations.text: B-flat seventh gives way to E-flat. Appoggiaturas and leading notes settle at different moments after the bass arrives.

annotations.title: One brief shared arrival
annotations.text: The final two beats settle into a shared E-flat-major chord.
